## Documentation Issue Summary
A clear and concise description of what documentation needs improvement.

## Documentation Type
What type of documentation needs improvement?
- [ ] User documentation (how-to guides, feature explanations)
- [ ] API documentation (for developers/integrations)
- [ ] Code documentation (inline comments, KDoc)
- [ ] Architecture documentation (system design, technical specs)
- [ ] Contributing guidelines (development process)
- [ ] README files (project setup, overview)
- [ ] FAQ/Help content (common questions)
- [ ] Release notes/changelog
- [ ] Other: ___________

## Specific Documentation
Which specific document or section needs improvement?
- **File/Page**: [e.g. README.md, User Guide - Exercise Management, API Reference]
- **Section**: [e.g. Getting Started, Installation, Feature X Configuration]
- **URL**: [If applicable, link to online documentation]

## Problem Description
What's wrong with the current documentation?

### Issue Category
- [ ] **Missing Information** - Important information is not documented
- [ ] **Outdated Information** - Documentation doesn't match current functionality
- [ ] **Incorrect Information** - Documentation contains errors
- [ ] **Unclear Instructions** - Steps are confusing or hard to follow
- [ ] **Poor Organization** - Information is hard to find or poorly structured
- [ ] **Missing Examples** - Need more practical examples or screenshots
- [ ] **Technical Errors** - Code samples don't work or have syntax errors
- [ ] **Accessibility Issues** - Documentation isn't accessible to all users
- [ ] **Translation Issues** - Problems with non-English documentation

### Detailed Description
Explain the specific problem with the current documentation:
- What information is missing, incorrect, or unclear?
- What confusion does this create for users/developers?
- How did you discover this issue?
